versions.content: Names shall allow to indicate if the value is a direct measurement or a conditioned value Type: Valid Description: Names should indicate if the value is measured from sensors (maybe of-set compensated and/or filtered) or calculated/estimated from a set of information or model based. Rationale: -- Use Case: Sensor SW-C outputting a measured physical value and feeding it to another SW-C in charge of filtering it. In this case the names of data elements, ports, and interface would differ only for a keyword, and the data type could be the same. Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: Possible solution: use a dedicated keyword in the name semantic to indicate such information.
